records.research_question: When a previously delivered decisive document fact is masked, GLM will use optional bounded archive recovery to improve first-proposal correctness compared with the forced-submission baseline.
stop_conditions: Do not begin while original controller is active.
No provider retry or replacement row.
Stop on source drift, uncertain reservation, transport or worker cleanup failure.

records.claim: Delayed correct first proposals: baseline 0/6, recovery 3/6; net wins 3; decisive recovery delivered at final synthesis in 4/6 candidate trials.
limitations: Answer presence can arise from echoed text; verified archive delivery is reported separately.
One small task family and clustered repeats; pilot only.
Ordinary masking is not recycling continuity.

records.next_action: Review retained failure stages and actual recovery choices before proposing another intervention.
